title: Hard Attend
subtitle: Score three items, pick the highest exactly, and read its value two ways that agree.

chapters.title: Closer Wins
chapters.blurb: A two-number key turns "which item is nearest the query?" into "which score is highest?".

chapters.title: One Winner, Two Reads
chapters.blurb: The first highest score wins, ties go left, and a one-hot sum and a direct index read return the same value.

chapters.title: Soft Versus Exact
chapters.blurb: Softmax only approaches the exact read, never at a tie, and the scored-selection question stays open.
